title: Shapes of Carbon Compounds: sp³, sp², sp
summary: Methane, ethene and ethyne all contain carbon but have different shapes. Hybridisation, and a quick way to find it.

notes.title: 03 – Shapes of Carbon Compounds: sp³, sp², sp

keyPoints: **sp³:** 4 single bonds, tetrahedral, about 109.5°, as in methane.
**sp²:** one double bond, trigonal planar, 120°, as in ethene.
**sp:** one triple bond, linear, 180°, as in ethyne.
**Shortcut:** count the groups around carbon: 4 is sp³, 3 is sp², 2 is sp.
More **s character** (25%, 33%, 50%) means shorter, stronger bonds.
